invariants.rationale: The method returns a non-null Iterator<List<WriteStatus>> in all non-exception cases.
The result is always an Iterator, as per the method's return type and usage.
partition is used to get bucket info and in string concatenation; it should not be null.
partitioner is cast and methods are called on it; it must not be null to avoid NullPointerException.
instantTime is typically a non-null, non-empty session/timestamp string used in commit context.
